label: default agent • install a plugin by id (declarative apply)
query: Install the plugin osaurus.standup-notes from the registry.
notes: Plugins are a desired-state list of registry ids: listing one that isn't installed installs it. The id is a nonexistent fixture with a PLAUSIBLE name — the earlier 'osaurus.eval-fixture-nonexistent' id made models correctly spot the fake and refuse, so the case measured fake-name detection instead of install routing (same trap the model-download case fixed). The id is not in the registry, so the install fails fast with a typed error (no real install / no lingering download); the selection assertion matches the emitted apply.
